spans.s:
अक्ष् अक्ष् (probably not a simple rt.,
perhaps a kind of old Desid. form of rt.
1. अश्), cl. 1. P. अक्षति, cl. 5. अक्ष्णोति, आनक्ष,
अक्षिष्यति, अक्ष्यति, आक्षीत्, अक्षितुम् or अष्टुम्,
to reach; to pass through, penetrate, pervade, embrace;
to accumulate (to form the cube ?): Caus. अक्षयति,
[]
यितुम्, आचिक्षत्, to cause to pervade: Desid. अचि-
क्षिषति or अचिक्षति.

अक्ष 1. अक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. अश् or अज्?),
an axle, axis, pivot, (in this sense also अम्, n.); a
wheel, car, cart; pole of a car; the beam of a balance
or string which holds the pivot of the beam; a snake;
terrestrial latitude; the lower part of the temples
[cf. Lat. axis; Gr. ἄξων Old Germ. ahsa; Mod.
Germ. Achse; Lith. assis].
—अक्ष-कर्ण, अस्, m.
the hypotenuse, especially of the triangle formed with
the gnomon of a dial and its shadow; (in astronomy)
argument of the latitude.
—अक्ष-ज, अस्, m. a dia-
mond; a thunderbolt; a N. of Viṣṇu.
—अक्ष-धुर्,
ऊर्, f. the yoke attached to the fore part of the pole of
a car.
—अक्ष-धूर्तिल, अस्, m. a bull, an ox, i. e.
yoked to the pole of a cart.
—अक्ष-पीडा, f.,
N. of a plant.
—अक्ष-भाग, अस्, m. a degree of
latitude.
—अक्ष-भार, अस्, m. cart-load, carriage-
load.
—अक्षांस (˚ष-अं˚), अस्, m. a degree of
latitude.
—अक्षाग्र (˚ष-अग्˚), अम्, n. the end of
an axle; the anterior end of the pole of a car; an
axle.
—अक्षाग्र-कील or -कीलक, अस्, m. a linch-
pin; the pin which fastens the yoke to the pole.
—अक्षा-नह्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. tied to a cart or its pole.

अक्ष 2. अक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be from rt. 1.
अश्, a die for playing with; a cube; a seed of which
rosaries are made (in compound words, like इन्द्रा-
क्ष, रुद्राक्ष); a shrub producing that seed (Eleo-
carpus Ganitrus); a weight called कर्ष, equal to 16
māṣas; Beleric Myrobalan (Terminalia Belerica), the
seed of which is used as a die; (अम्), n. sochal salt;
blue vitriol (from its crystallized shape).
—अक्ष-
कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in dice.
—अक्ष-ग्लह,
अस्, m. gambling, playing at dice.
—अक्ष-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, skilled in gambling.
—अक्ष-तत्त्व, अम्, n.
science of dice.
—अक्षतत्त्व-विद्, त्, त्, त्, skilled in
the principles of gambling.
—अक्ष-देवन, अम्,
n. gambling, dice-playing.
—अक्ष-देविन्, ई, m. a
gamester.
—अक्ष-द्यू, ऊस्, m. a gambler, a dice-
player.
—अक्ष-द्यूत, अस्, m. a gambler, a dice-
player; (अम्), n. gambling.
—अक्ष-द्यूतिक, अम्,
n. dispute at play.
—अक्ष-द्रुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्,
hated by, i. e. unlucky at dice.
—अक्ष-धर, अस्, आ
or ई, अम्, one who has dice; (अस्), m. a plant, Trophis
Aspera; see साखोत.
—अक्ष-धूर्त, अस्, m. a game-
ster, a gambler, i. e. a dice-rogue.
—अक्ष-नैपुण or
-नैपुण्य, अम्, n. skill in gambling.
—अक्ष-परा-
जय, अस्, m. loss in gambling.
—अक्ष-पात, अस्, m.
cast of dice.
—अक्ष-पातन, अम्, n. act of casting dice.
—अक्ष-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of dice, or (perhaps)
favoured by the dice, lucky.
—अक्ष-मद, अस्, m.
intoxicating passion for dice.
—अक्ष-मात्र, अम्, n.
dice, anything as big as dice; the twinkling of an eye, a
moment of time.
—अक्ष-माला, f. a rosary, a string
or necklace of beads, especially of the seeds of the
Eleocarpus; a N. of Arunḍhatī, wife of Vasiṣṭha,
from her wearing a rosary; (अस्, आ, अम्), or अक्ष-
मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing a rosary of seeds.
—अक्ष-
राज, अस्, m. the king of dice, the die called Kali.
—अक्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having dice, relating to
dice, gambling; (ती), f. a game of dice.
—अक्ष-
वाम, अस्, m. an unfair gambler.
—१. अक्ष-विद्,
त्, त्, त्, skilful in gambling.
—अक्ष-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
what has occurred in gambling.
—अक्ष-शौण्ड, अस्,
आ, अम्, fond of gambling.
—अक्ष-सूत्र, अम्, n. a
string or rosary of Eleocarpus seeds.
—अक्ष-स्तुष,
अस्, m. Beleric Myrobalan.
—अक्ष-हृदय, अम्, n.
innermost nature of dice, perfect skill in gambling.
—अक्षहृदय-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, perfectly skilled in
gambling.
—अक्षावपन (˚ष-आव्˚), अम्, n. a dice-
beard.
—अक्षावाप or अक्षातिवाप (˚ष-अत्˚),
अस्, m. the keeper of the dice, or of a gambling table.

अक्ष 3. अक्ष, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. अश्?), an organ
of sense, an object of sense; (अस्), m. the soul; know-
ledge, religious knowledge; the law; a lawsuit;
a person born blind; N. of Garuḍa, of a son of
Rāvaṇa, of a son of Nara, &c.
—अक्ष-दर्शक, अस्,
[]
m. a judge, i. e. one who sees lawsuits; also अक्ष-
दृश्, क्.
—अक्ष-पटल, अम्, n. court of law; de-
pository of legal document.
—अक्ष-पाट, अस्, m. an
arena, a wrestling ground, place of contest.
—अक्ष-
पाटक or अक्ष-पाटिक, अस्, m. a judge, i. e. ar-
ranger of a lawsuit.
—अक्ष-पाद, अस्, m. a follower
of the Nyāya or logical system of philosophy; N. of
the Ṛṣi Gotama.
—अक्ष-वाट, see अक्ष-पाट.
 — 2. अक्ष-विद्, त्, त्, त्, versed in law.

अक्ष 4. अक्ष, अम्, n. the eye, especially
substituted for अक्षि at the end of adjective com-
pounds, the fem. being अक्षी [cf. Gr. ὄσσο, ὄκκο
for ὄξο Lat. oculus; Germ. Auge; Russ. òko].

2. अक्ष; add — the collar-bone (Ved.); a mesh
(of a net).

अक्षक or अक्षिक, अस्, m. the tree Dalbergia
Oujeinensis.
अक्षक; add — (probably) the collar-bone.
अक्षण अ-क्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, inopportune.

अक्षत्र अ-क्षत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of the
Kṣatriya caste, apart from the Kṣatriya caste.

अक्षन् अक्षन्, substituted for अक्षि, the eye,
in the weakest cases, see
Gram. 122
[cf. Goth. augan].
अक्षन्, an organ of sense.
अक्षण्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having eyes.

अक्षम अ-क्षम, अस्, आ, अम्, unable to en-
dure, impatient; incompetent.
—अ-क्षमा or अक्ष-
म-ता, f. impatience, envy; incompetence.

अक्षय अ-क्षय, अस्, आ, अम्, exempt from
decay, undecaying; (अस्), m., N. of the twentieth year
in the cycle of Jupiter; (आ), f. the seventh day of
a lunar month, if it fall on Sunday or Monday; the
fourth, if it fall on Wednesday.
—अक्षय-गुण, अस्,
आ, अम्, possessing imperishable qualities; (अस्), m. Śiva.
—अक्षय-ता, f. or अक्षय-त्व, अम्, n. imperish-
ableness.
—अक्षय-तृतीया, f. a festival, the third
day of the bright half of Vaiśākha, which is the first
day of the Satya-yuga, and secures permanency to ac-
tions then performed.
—अक्षय-पुरुहूत, अस्, m.
Śiva.
—अक्षय-मति, इस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—अक्षय-लोक, अस्, m. the undecaying world, hea-
ven.
—अक्षया-ललिता, f. festival observed by women
on the seventh day of the second half of Bhādra.
अ-क्षय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, undecaying.

अ-क्षयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, undecaying; (इणी), f., N. of
Śiva's wife.

अक्षर अ-क्षर, अस्, आ, अम्, imperishable;
unalterable; (अस्), m. a sword; Śiva; Viṣṇu; (अम्),
n. a syllable; the syllable ॐ; a letter; a vowel, a
sound; a word; speech; Brahma; final beatitude;
abiding merit, religious austerity; sacrifice; right,
justice; the sky; water; a plant (Achyranthes Aspera).
—अक्षर-चञ्चु or अक्षर-चुञ्चु, उस्, or अक्ष-
र-चण or अक्षर-चन, अस्, m. a writer, scribe.
—अक्षर-च्छन्दस्, अस्, n. metre regulated by the
number and quantity of syllables.
—अक्षर-जननी,
f. a reed or pen.
—अक्षर-जीवक or अक्षर-
जीविक, अस्, or अक्षर-जीविन्, ई, m. a scribe.
—अक्ष-
र-जुर्, ऊर्, m. a sage, one who knows and enjoys
Brahma.
—अक्षर-तूलिका, f. a reed or pen.
—अक्षर-न्यास or अक्षर-विन्यास, अस्, m. array
of syllables or letters, writing; scripture; the alphabet.
—अक्षर-पङ्क्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, containing five syllables;
(इस्), f., N. of a metre of four lines, each containing
one dactyl and one spondee; also called पङ्क्ति or
हंस.
—अक्षर-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. entitled to a
share in the syllables (of a prayer).
—अक्षर-मुख,
अस्, m. having the mouth full of syllables, a student,
scholar.
—अक्षर-विन्यास, see अक्षर-न्यास.
—अक्षर-शस्, ind. syllable by syllable.
—अक्ष-
र-शून्य, अस्, आ, अम्, inarticulate.
—अक्षर-
संस्थान, अम्, n. scripture, writing.
—अक्षराङ्ग
(˚र-अङ्ग), अम्, n. part of a syllable.

अक्षार अ-क्षार, अस्, आ, अम्, free from facti-
tious salt; (अस्), m. natural salt.
—अक्षार-लवण or
अक्षारालवण, अम्, n. natural salt; food that may be
eaten at a season unfit for performing religious duties.
आ-क्षार, अस्, m. calumny, accusation.
अक्षरक, अम्, n. a vowel.
अक्षर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to syllables or letters.

अक्षान्ति अ-क्षान्ति, इस्, f. impatience,
jealousy, intolerance.

अक्षि अक्षि, n. (fr. rt. 1. अश् or अञ्ज्? Instr.
अक्ष्णा, Dat. अक्ष्णे &c., fr. अक्षन्, substituted for
अक्षि in the weakest cases. At the end of comp.
अक्ष is substituted, see 4. अक्ष), the eye; the
number two; (ई), du., Ved. the sun and moon [cf.
Lith. aki-s].
—अक्षि-कूट or अक्षि-कूटक, अम्, n.
the eyeball, the pupil of the eye.
—अक्षि-गत, अस्,
आ, अम्, visibly present, seen; hated.
—अक्षि-गोल,
अस्, m. the eyeball.
—अक्षि-जाह, अम्, n. the root
of the eye.
—अक्षि-तारा, f. the pupil of the eye.
—अक्षि-पक्ष्मन्, अ, n. the eyelash.
—अक्षि-
पटल, अम्, n. a coat of the eye.
—अक्षि-पत्, त्, त्,
त्, Ved. (falling into the eyes), hurtful; (त्), ind. as
much as could fall into the eyes, a little.
—अक्षि-
भू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, visible, perceptible, manifest, present.
—अक्षि-भेषज, अम्, n. a medicament for the
eyes, collyrium, &c.; (अस्), m. a tree, Red Lodh.
—अक्षि-भ्रुव, अम्, n. the eyes and eyebrows to-
gether.
—अक्षि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, provided with eyes.
—अक्षि-लोमन्, अ, n. the eyelash.
—अक्षि-विकूणित,
अम्, n. a glance, a look with the eyelids partially closed.

आक्षि आ-क्षि, cl. 2. 6. P. -क्षेति, -क्षियति,
-क्षेतुम्, to abide, dwell in, stay at (with acc.);
to inhabit; to exist; to possess, take possession of
(with acc.).

अक्षिक or अक्षीक, अस्, m. the tree Dalbergia
Oujeinensis. See अक्षक.
अक्षीक अक्षीक, अस्, m. See अक्षिक.

आक्षिक आक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. अक्ष),
relating or belonging to a die or to gambling, &c.;
won at dice; (अम्), n. a gambling debt, money lost
at play; (अस्), m., N. of the tree Morinda Tinc-
toria.
—आक्षिक-पण, अस्, m. a stake, a wager, a
bet.

अक्षिणी अक्षिणी, f. (fr. 3. अक्ष ?), one of
the eight conditions or privileges attached to landed
property.

अक्षित अ-क्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, undecayed, un-
injured; undecaying; (अम्), n. water.
—अक्षिता-वसु,
उस्, m., Ved. epithet of Indra (possessed of undecaying
wealth).
—अक्षितोति (˚त-ऊति), इस्, m., Ved. epithet of
Indra (granting permanent help).

अ-क्षिति, इस्, f. imperishableness; (इस्, इस्, इ), im-
perishable.

अक्षियत् अ-क्षियत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. not
inhabiting, destitute of a dwelling, unsettled; (Sāy.)
not decreasing (in riches).

अक्षिव अक्षिव or अक्षीव, अस्, m. a plant,
Guilandina or Hyperanthera Moringa; (अम्), n. sea salt.

अक्षीव अ-क्षीव, अस्, आ, अम्, not intoxicated,
sober. See also अक्षिव.

आक्षीव आक्षीव, अस्, m., N. of the plant
Morunga Guilandina and Hyperanthera. See
अक्षिव.
अक्षु अक्षु, उस्, m., Ved. a kind of net.

अक्षुण्ण अ-क्षुण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, unbroken, un-
curtailed, unconquered; inexperienced, inexpert.
—अ-
क्षुण्ण-ता, f. uncurtailed condition; inexperience.
अक्षुद्र अ-क्षुद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not small.
अक्षुध् अ-क्षुध्, त्, f., Ved. satiety.
अ-क्षुध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not liable to hunger.

अक्षेत्र अ-क्षेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of
fields, uncultivated; (अम्), n. not a proper field, a bad
field; not a proper geometrical figure.
—अक्षेत्र-
ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम् or अक्षेत्र-विद्, त्, त्, त्, destitute of
spiritual knowledge.
अ-क्षेत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having no fields.
अक्षैत्रज्ञ्य, अम्, n. spiritual ignorance.

आक्षैत्रज्ञ्य आक्षैत्रज्ञ्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-क्षे-
त्रज्ञ, q. v.), spiritual ignorance.

अक्षोट अक्षोट, अस्, m. a walnut (Pistacio
nut ?); N. of a tree, Pīlu; of another tree, Aleurites
Triloba. Also spelt अक्षोड, अक्षोडक, आक्षोट,
आक्षोडक, आखोट.

आक्षोट आक्षोट or आक्षोड, अस् or अम् (?),
m. or n. (?) a walnut (Pistacio nut ?); N. of a tree,
Pīlu; also of another tree, Aleurites Triloba. See
अक्षोट.

अक्षोभ अ-क्षोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, unagitated,
unmoved; (अस्), m. the post to which an elephant is
tied; freedom from agitation, imperturbability.

अ-क्षोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, immoveable, imperturba-
ble; (अस्), m., N. of a Buddha; an immense number,
said by Buddhists to be 100 vivaras.

अक्षौहिणी अक्षौहिणी, f. an army consisting
[]
of ten anīkinīs, or 21, 870 elephants, 21, 870 chariots,
65, 610 horse, and 109, 350 foot. (The anīkinī con-
sists of 27 vāhinīs; and 27 being the cube, अक्ष,
of 3, it is probable that अक्षौहिणी is a compound
from अक्ष and वाहिनी.)

अक्ष्ण अक्ष्ण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. अश्), Ved.
time (= अ-खण्ड Schol. to Uṇ-sūtras).

अक्ष्णया अक्ष्णया (probably the Instr. of
an obs. word अक्ष्णा, fr. अञ्च्), ind., Ved. circuitously
(like a wheel), in a tortuous way; wrongly.
—अक्ष्ण-
या-द्रुह्, -ध्रुक्, क्, क्, Ved. seeking to injure in a
tortuous manner.
—अक्ष्ण-यावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved.
going across; (Sāy.) going through, penetrating.

आक्षद्यूतिक आक्षद्यूतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, effected
or completed by gambling. See अक्ष-द्यूत under
3. अक्ष.

आक्षपण आ-क्षपण, अम्, n. (rt. 1. क्षप्),
fasting, purification by fasting, abstinence.

आक्षपाटिक आक्षपाटिक, अस्, m. a judge.
See अक्ष-पाटक under 2. अक्ष.

आक्षपाद आक्षपाद, अस्, m. a follower of
the Nyāya doctrine; a logician. See under 2. अक्ष.

आक्षभारिक आक्षभारिक. See Gaṇa to
Pāṇini

आक्षर् आ-क्षर्, cl. 10. P. -क्षारयति, -यि-
तुम्, to abuse, revile, accuse, punish. (Sometimes
regarded as a nom. fr. the next.)

आ-क्षारण, अम्, आ, n. f. abuse; calumnious ac-
cusation (especially of adultery).

आ-क्षारित, अस्, आ, अम्, calumniated, falsely ac-
cused; accused of adultery or fornication; guilty,
criminal; reviled, abused.

आ-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. abiding, dwelling in, stay-
ing at.

आक्षिप् आ-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते,
-क्षेप्तुम्, to cast or throw at or down; to strike
with a bolt; to draw near or together, to contract,
convulse, cause to tremble; to draw or take off or
away, withdraw; to chase or drive out of a place;
to hang out or expose to view; put into; point to,
apply to, refer to, hint, indicate; to refuse, not to
have regard to, refuse as wrong; to insult, deride;
to say or state ironically: Caus. P. -क्षेपयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to throw down.

आ-क्षिपत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, casting, striking,
tossing, sending; reviling, abusing; excelling so as
to reproach or put to shame.

आ-क्षिप्तिका, f. a particular air or song which is
sung by a person approaching the stage.
आ-क्षिप्य, ind. having spurned, having insulted.

आ-क्षेप, अस्, m. throw, toss, drawing together or
near to one's self, attraction, convulsion, palpitation;
hinting; applying, laying on (as a colour); throwing
away, giving up; sustaining (as a sound); reviling,
abuse, censure, blame, reproach; objection; doubt,
irony (as a figure in rhetoric).

आ-क्षेपक, अस्, इका, अम्, blaming, censuring, re-
viling; (अस्), m. a thrower, a detractor, a calumniator
or accuser; sickness, disease; convulsion, spasm.
आ-क्षेपण, अम्, n. throwing, tossing.

आ-क्षेपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, applying to, concerning; (also
= आ-क्षेपक.)

आक्षोदन आक्षोदन, अम्, n. hunting (also
आच्छोदन).

आक्ष्णु आ-क्ष्णु, cl. 2. P. -क्ष्णौति, -क्ष्ण-
वितुम्, to rub, polish up; sharpen.

आक्ष्यत् आ-क्ष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fut. part. fr.
अक्ष् or अश् with आ ?); आक्ष्यन्ति अहानि, days leading
to completion, complemental days; the N. of certain
days on which the ceremony Ayana, performed for
the Ādityās and Aṅgirasas, is finished.

अक्ष-धर; for ‘see साखोत’ read — see शा-
